Chapter 1019: Chapter 27 Massive World-Breaking Origin Force (Added Chapter, Requesting Monthly Pass)

“This is…”

Lin Yuan felt a slight shock in his heart.

Just now, as the universe began to shatter, massive areas of the Fringe Starfield collapsed.

Lin Yuan immediately noticed that the speed at which he accumulated World-Breaking Origin Force began to soar.

Until now, after numerous tests by Lin Yuan.

The upper limit of World-Breaking Origin Force accumulation speed had always been locked at the efficiency of accumulating a strand every ninety days.

As for an increase?

Even if Lin Yuan actively tore through the universe’s void, creating an unprecedented Eternal Spatial Rift.

It still couldn’t increase the accumulation speed of World-Breaking Origin Force.

But now.

Lin Yuan clearly felt that the accumulation speed of World-Breaking Origin Force was skyrocketing.

Not just increasing.

It was skyrocketing.

From the initial ninety days per strand.

To fifty days per strand.

Twenty days per strand.

One day per strand.

Ten strands per day.

A thousand strands per day.

…

As the great disintegration of the universe continued, more and more Star Domains collapsed.

The accumulation speed of World-Breaking Origin Force seemed to be endlessly increasing.

In just a few dozen breaths.

Lin Yuan had accumulated hundreds of strands of World-Breaking Origin Force.

“The great disintegration of the universe, does it really help accumulate World-Breaking Origin Force so much?”

Lin Yuan was pleasantly surprised; all along, he couldn’t comprehend what kind of energy World-Breaking Origin Force truly was.

If not for the Myriad Realms Gate’s accumulation, he wouldn’t have been aware of World-Breaking Origin Force at all.

And ever since Lin Yuan stepped into the twelfth tier, more uses of the Myriad Realms Gate had been discovered, among which World-Breaking Origin Force played a nearly omnipotent role.

In theory, as long as there is enough World-Breaking Origin Force, even a Chaos Great Saint or a Great Saint would be suppressed without resistance.

And suppression is just the most trivial aspect of World-Breaking Origin Force. Its most crucial use is creation, is omnipotence.

“Over a thousand strands of World-Breaking Origin Force now.”

In Lin Yuan’s contemplation, he found that the World-Breaking Origin Force he had accumulated had unknowingly increased by a thousand strands.

A thousand strands of World-Breaking Origin Force, at the usual accumulation rate, would take two or three hundred years.

But how long has it been now? Not even ten minutes!

“This great disintegration of the universe…”

Lin Yuan felt a joy in his heart, didn’t expect that the great disintegration of the universe was not entirely a bad thing.

At least according to the current rate of World-Breaking Origin Force accumulation, from the beginning to the end of this universal apocalypse, the number of World-Breaking Origin Force he finally acquires will start at least in the millions of strands.

“Is it because the universe is completely collapsing?”

Lin Yuan speculated, initially, he thought the great disintegration of the universe was related to the Eternal Spatial Rift.

Because being under the Eternal Spatial Rift would increase World-Breaking Origin Force accumulation speed to a certain extent until it was fixed at an accumulation rate of ninety strands per day.

But until he stepped into the twelfth tier, he didn’t realize that was not the case.

Being close to an Eternal Spatial Rift can increase the accumulation speed, not because of the Rift itself, but because it’s closer to the Chaos Void.

Until the Eternal Spatial Rift is vast enough, the void breath that spills into the universe reaches its extreme, akin to being in the Chaos Void; then the accumulation speed of World-Breaking Origin Force stands at ninety days per strand.

For example, now, one of Lin Yuan’s avatars was in the Chaos Void, even without other avatars beside the Eternal Spatial Rift, the accumulation speed of World-Breaking Origin Force is still ninety days per strand.

The accumulation speed of ninety days per strand is the normal rate under the Chaos Void.

“Forget it.”

Lin Yuan pondered for a moment, without any leads, the rebirth of the collapsed universe is the result of the Chaos Void rules, and even a Great Saint cannot comprehend it, thinking about these at the moment was meaningless.

…

Crash.

Massive areas of the starry sky crumbled, turning into nothingness.

One by one, the twelfth-tier ultimate beings immediately began transferring the life essence imprints of the Universe Clan people inside them.

At this moment, as the universe rapidly disintegrated, the Origin Source consciousness fell into unprecedented weakness; transferring the life imprints of the universe creatures within them now meant less backlash.

The river of time began to dry up gradually.

Many twelfth-tier ultimate beings took action, transferring all life imprints to the river of time within their internal universe.

Suddenly, varying degrees of backlash struck.

Many twelfth-tier ultimate beings appeared solemn, silently bearing the backlash from the universe itself.

The backlash they endured was like ripples on a calm water surface stirred by an undercurrent.

Each twelfth-tier ultimate being knew well, having not carried more life than they could bear into their internal universe, the backlash they faced was within the estimated range.

“It’s my turn.”

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged under the starry sky, seeing many twelfth-tier ultimate beings withstanding the backlash from the universe’s Origin Source consciousness, he too immediately began transferring all citizens’ life imprints from his internal universe.

Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!

If the transfer of the life essence imprints of world spirits inside other twelfth-tier ultimate beings was like ripples stirred on a calm surface.

Then when Lin Yuan began transferring the life essence imprints of countless citizens from his internal universe, the surface was not merely stirred into ripples but directly boiled, as if it exploded.

The Origin Source consciousness of the universe, which was originally weak and about to fall asleep, suddenly jolted awake, incredulously sensing the constant disappearance of innumerable life essence imprints within the universe.

Rumble.

Unparalleled backlash converged, enveloping Lin Yuan, as other twelfth-tier ultimate beings sensed this backlash, they couldn’t help but tremble inside.

If it were them facing such backlash, they would likely turn to ashes in an instant, unable to endure even a few breaths.

“It’s the strongest in the galaxy.”
